sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This redemption is achieved through the service of Torah study, acts of kindness, and communal prayer, which operate from the inner dimension of the Torah and the innermost levels of the crown.

translations.translation: Now, this redemption is through the service of engaging in Torah study,
acts of kindness, and communal prayer.
For the matter of engaging in Torah is the innermost aspect of Torah,
which is the aspect of the Tree of Life
(not like the revealed part of Torah that is clothed in the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil),
meaning that the clarification achieved through the innermost aspect of Torah is not in a manner of war at all
(nor even like the king's going out and traveling to the place of the enemy),
therefore,
through this the redemption is accomplished in peace,
so that the existence of the enemy is nullified.
And so it is with acts of kindness,
for acts of kindness draw from the innermost aspect of the Keter down to the aspect of Malchus of Malchus,
as mentioned above.
And so too with communal prayer,
for communal prayer is like the prayer of the Ten Days of Repentance,
and as our sages, of blessed memory, said
on the verse,
"Seek Hashem when He is found,"
here for an individual, here for the community,
and communal prayer is the drawing down of the innermost aspect of the Keter.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This explains the connection of this peaceful redemption to the Alter Rebbe's redemption, which is the spreading of the wellsprings outward, drawing the innermost aspect of the Keter to the lowest level of Malchus.

translations.translation: And based on this, the connection of "He redeemed in peace" to the redemption of our Rebbe, the Alter Rebbe, whose essence is the spreading of the wellsprings outward, will be understood.
For the matter of the spreading of the wellsprings outward is that even to the aspect of Malchus of Malchus, as it is in the aspect of "outward," the wellsprings are drawn there,
not only the living waters drawn from the wellsprings, but the wellsprings themselves,
the drawing down of the innermost aspect of the Keter
(wellsprings)
to the aspect of Malchus of Malchus, etc.
(outward).
And this is that through the spreading of the wellsprings outward, "Ati Mar, the King Moshiach," will come
(as in the well-known holy letter of the Baal Shem Tov, of blessed memory),
for the spreading of the wellsprings outward is the matter of drawing down the innermost aspect of the Keter to the aspect of Malchus of Malchus,
as mentioned above.
And it is like one who engages in Torah, acts of kindness, and prays with the community, through which "He redeemed me and my sons from among the nations,"
at which time "the spirit of impurity I will remove from the earth,"
and "Hashem will be King over all the earth; on that day Hashem will be One and His Name One."
